Simple Onboarding

Get your team up and running in 48 hours.

PatrolPilot is designed for quick adoption. Most security companies are fully operational within two days of signing up.

Build your first schedule

Use the drag-and-drop scheduler to assign guards to shifts. The system automatically checks licence validity and overtime rules. Guards receive instant push notifications when rostered.

Guards use the mobile app

Guards download the free PatrolPilot app (iOS & Android), clock in with GPS verification, scan NFC checkpoints on patrol, submit incident reports and activate SOS alerts — all from one app.
